In this masterclass you study temples in economic, political and social history.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. It can be given online or at your venue, as a single session or as part of a series.

What it covers

  • Institution & economy
  • People & labour
  • Change over time

How the time is spent

  1. Institution & economy 30 min

    Endowments and land grants from documented cases.

    You: evidence table

  2. People & labour 60 min

    Craftspeople, servants, clergy and surrounding settlements.

    You: role map

  3. Change over time 30 min

    Compare dynasties without timeless stereotypes.

    You: timeline

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Describe how endowments and land grants supported temples, using documented cases.
  • Identify the craftspeople, servants, clergy and settlements connected with a temple.
  • Compare temples across dynasties without relying on timeless stereotypes.
